threat_model.agent: cooperative benchmark participant, not an adversary attempting account-level exfiltration or artifact forgery
threat_model.provider_account_isolation: fresh local Hermes sessions; no cryptographic exclusion of durable provider-account side channels
threat_model.provider_call_evidence: runner start/completion markers plus Hermes session identifiers and quota telemetry; not provider-signed receipts
threat_model.claim_limit: exploratory mechanism evidence only; no cryptographic provider-accounting or adversarial-isolation claim

controlled_starts.agent_visible_leakage_policy: reject MUTANT, AGENTHARNESS_MUTANT, every evaluator check id, symlinks and runtime residue

design.review: one mandatory local opaque finding delivered only to B; A receives only local pytest evidence
design.cloned_start: A and B byte/metadata identical before condition operations
design.prompt_contrast: A receives the hardened local-pytest baseline prompt; B receives the hardened AgentHarness feedback prompt
design.heldout: physically separate evaluator called only after both paired invocations
design.endpoint: binary one iff target defect and every guard pass
design.exactly_once: eight durable repair-start markers, no initial marker or initial provider call
design.resume: run root is non-resumable after any repair-start marker

go_rule.b_feedback: delivered, immutable, and exactly accounted in every B cell
go_rule.invalid: any provider, harness, endpoint, marker, or accounting failure
